reviews.title: OneDealOutlet Photo is the wrong AIO.
reviews.comment: Review update: Shipping took 10 days to arrive. Beware of photo, it is of the SL infinity fans which is the 2nd version of this AIO, not the one described. The wiring of this AIO boarders on indecipherable and is unnecessarily complex and needs some kind of hub. The 2nd (SL) iteration of this AIO does come with a fan hub but it is of a Lian Li (proprietary?) design and only works with other Lian Li Uni fans. This is because the RGB connector of the fans is a unique, nonstandard design. One of the other reviewers mentioned they might get an adaptor for this connector from China, save yourself the trouble and avoid this AIO. I gave the AIO to my builder (he uses a lot of Lian Li PC cases) he may find a use for it. I decided to eat the $120 (I don't want to deal with this company). I mark it down as a lesson learned: Only buy product sold by or through Amazon. Fool me once shame on you, fool me twice shame on me! Note: You'll find this listing by typing " Lian Li AIO cooler 240mm white " on Amazon page. You won't find it at the OneDealOutlet storefront.
reviews.author: Rick Philpott

reviews.title: pump died after two months, fans noisy
reviews.comment: the fans oscillate and make a noticeable whining sound. going to replace fans. don't care about the pretty lights just want it to work. updated review because after only about two months the pump died. started making a bearing grinding noise, and temps started rising.
reviews.author: chris
